title: PartAdder part.json
description: Describes one custom part. Paths are relative to the folder that contains this file.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint so part.json files get autocompletion and validation.

formatVersion.description: Format version. Reserved for future migrations.

id.description: Unique id inside the pack. Defaults to the folder name. Changing it changes the automatic defindex, which breaks saved crafts.

mass.description: Mass in kg. Without it the loader computes the mass from the volume of the mesh (1000 kg/m3).

assemblyPosition.description: Editor sort order inside the category.

defindex.description: Persistent part id. Leave empty to derive one from pack id and part id.

model.description: Mesh path relative to the part folder (.obj, .fbx, .glb, .gltf, .dae, .stl, .ply, .3ds, .blend).

units.description: Units the mesh is authored in.

scale.description: Extra multiplier applied on top of units.

reentryModel.description: Optional mesh used as the reentry shell of the part. Without it a simple shell is generated.

icon.description: Shop thumbnail (PNG/JPG). Falls back to the category icon.

attachments.description: Attachment points. At least one is required.

centerOfMassAdjustment.description: Centre of mass offset in metres.

radialSnapping.description: Radial symmetry step in degrees while the part is placed; 0 disables radial snapping and -1 (the default) keeps the setting of the player.

dynamicAttachmentConfigs.description: Surface sockets: the part receives other parts on its hull and/or can be attached to the hull of another part. Every entry names a config of the game; its sign says which end it is (see docs/PART_FORMAT.md). An entry the loader cannot use is dropped with a warning, so the rest of the part still loads.

dynamicCurrPivot.description: Point inside the hull of the part the game aims the surface socket at when this part is placed on another one. The origin (inside the mesh) suits most parts.

modules.description: Copied to RocketPartSchema.config verbatim. See docs/MODULES.md.

overrides.description: Advanced: raw RocketPartSchema fields merged after baking. defindex, prefabName and iconName are protected.

animations.description: Procedural motions of the model nodes, played by the mod itself.

path.description: Node of the model, for example model/antenna_y.

speed.description: Degrees per second (spin), or metres per second with translate.

stowed.description: Angle of the stowed pose (deploy), or offset in metres with translate.

deployed.description: Angle of the deployed pose (deploy), or offset in metres with translate.

duration.description: Duration of the pose change in seconds (deploy), or of the loop (keys); a keyed curve with a trigger plays once over this time.

trigger.description: Part state trigger that starts the motion (a deploy, or a one-shot curve with keys); it must be in the triggersData of Model.PartStateModule.

foldTrigger.description: Part state trigger that folds the node back. Without it every other transition folds the node back; the same name as trigger makes the transition a toggle.

translate.description: The motion moves the node along the axis instead of turning it: the numbers are metres.

pivot.description: The point the node turns around, in the space of the node. Zero turns it around its own origin.

keys.description: Keyframes of the motion (keys): the angle (or offset, with translate) over the time.

time.description: Time of the key in seconds.

angle.description: Angle in degrees, or offset in metres with translate.

smooth.description: True (the default) interpolates the segment smoothly, false linearly.

tint.description: Colour the part is tinted to when the trigger fires.

materials.description: Own material for single nodes of the model.

variants.description: Alternatives of the part, for example the propellant of a tank.

shader.description: Fallback shader name, used only when the game template material is unavailable.

nodeMaterial.description: Material of a single node of the model.

node.description: Node of the model, for example model/nozzle.

variant.description: One alternative of the part, for example the propellant of a tank.

id.description: Id of the variant inside the part.

name.description: Name shown in the fuel picker.

module.description: Module the variant changes (variants that use overrides).

overrides.description: Overrides the variant applies to the module.

subcategory.description: Group of the variant in the picker.

id.description: Connection id. Defaults to the array index. Keep it stable across versions.

name.description: Optional label for your own reference.

position.description: Centre of the connection box relative to the prefab origin.

rotation.description: Euler angles in degrees. Replaces direction when present.

spacing.description: Scales the preset socket spacing and connection box.

center.description: Centre of the connection box relative to position.

sockets.description: Explicit socket offsets in the attachment's local plane.

flags.description: Connection flags, combinable with commas: e.g. "dynamic, primary".

defindex.description: Id of a dynamic attachment config of the game. A positive id makes the part receive a part on its surface (10001000..10001003, 10001100..10001105, 20001000, 20001100, 30001000..30001018, 30001100..30001129), a negative one lets this part be put onto a surface (-10001000, -10001102..-10001105, -30001000..-30001018). See docs/PART_FORMAT.md.

shape.description: Connection shapes of the socket, combinable with commas: for example "single, dual". The socket only connects to a fixed connection of another part with a compatible shape.
